mapper.select: SELECT h.* FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE ORDER BY h.`handover_no`, h.`id`
SELECT h.* FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE ORDER BY h.`handover_no`, h.`id`

SELECT COUNT(1) AS `total`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.`source_facility_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `migratedCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.`source_facility_id` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `manualCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.`archive_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `archivedCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN (h.`agreement_no` IS NULL OR h.`agreement_no` = '') AND h.`agreement_date` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `missingAgreementCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.`maintenance_end` IS NOT NULL AND h.`maintenance_end` >= CURDATE() AND h.`maintenance_end` <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `maintenanceExpiringCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.`maintenance_end` IS NOT NULL AND h.`maintenance_end` < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `maintenanceExpiredCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN h.`remark` LIKE '%无匹配记录%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `orphanCount` FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE
SELECT h.`status` AS `status`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE GROUP BY h.`status` ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(h.`${column}`, ''), #{emptyLabel}) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(h.`${column}`, ''), #{emptyLabel}) ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(h.`handover_no`, '-', 2), '-', -1) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE h.`handover_no` LIKE 'YJ-%' AND GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(h.`handover_no`, '-', 2), '-', -1) ORDER BY `name`

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(h.`receive_unit`, ''), '未填写') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(h.`receive_unit`, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY `count` DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(h.`handover_no`, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM `t_road_handover` h WHERE h.`handover_no` LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(h.`handover_no`) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 4
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_archive` a WHERE a.`del_flag` = 0 AND a.`id` = #{archiveId}
